title: Onewheel vs Boosted Range per Temperature Band
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ride:session (platform="onewheel" OR platform="boosted") temperature_band=* range_miles=*
| stats avg(range_miles) as avg_range_miles, count as events by temperature_band
| sort - avg_range_miles
description: Shows average range miles by temperature band for micro-mobility range planning.
value: Average range miles by temperature band helps compare micro-mobility range planning across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `range_miles` on `ride:session` events and normalize `temperature_band` so Splunk can summarize performance by temperature band.
visualization: Bar chart of average range miles by temperature band.
grandmaExplanation: It produces the average range miles for each temperature band so you can see what works best for micro-mobility range planning.
